XPCOMUtils.defineLazyPreferenceGetter(
  lazy,
  "EXPERIMENTS_SUPPRESSED",
  "extensions.experiments.suppressed",
  false
);
XPCOMUtils.defineLazyPreferenceGetter(
  lazy,
  "EXPERIMENTS_ALLOWED",
  "extensions.experiments.allowed",
  "",
  null,
  val =>
    val
      .split(",")
      .map(s => s.trim())
      .filter(Boolean)
);
